name: Free AI YouTube Shorts Generator Professional Edition (Gemini Pro, Pexels and JSON2Video)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — sirf 3 FREE keys, koi credit card NAHI

1. **GEMINI_API_KEY** → free: [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) (Gemini 2.5 Pro free tier pe chalta hai)
   - `429 rate limit` aaye to `GEMINI_MODEL` ko `gemini-2.5-flash` kar do
2. **PEXELS_API_KEY** → free: [pexels.com/api](https://www.pexels.com/api/)
3. **JSON2VIDEO_API_KEY** → free: [json2video.com/get-api-key](https://json2video.com/get-api-key/) (render + Hindi voice + captions — sab isi ke free plan mein)
4. Last node pe apni **YouTube OAuth2** credential lagao

🎙️ **Voice** (Config mein badlo): `hi-IN-MadhurNeural` (male, default) • `hi-IN-SwaraNeural` (female) • `hi-IN-KunalNeural` (male) • English ke liye `en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural` + `LANGUAGE` = `English`

💰 **Cost: ₹0 per video** — bas niche wali limits dhyan mein rakhna.

## 🎬 Professional Edition — kya milta hai (FREE mein)

**TOPIC → ready-to-publish Short (2-4 min):**

1. **Gemini 2.5 Pro** professional script plan banata hai — SEO title, description (#Shorts hashtags), tags + 4 scenes (golden hook + Hindi voiceover + footage keyword)
2. **Pexels** har scene ke liye vertical cinematic stock footage
3. **JSON2Video** professional render: footage + **Hindi neural voiceover** + **auto-synced boxed captions** (karaoke style) + **golden hook title** + **fade transitions** + **branded FOLLOW outro** — 1080x1920, high quality
4. Auto-poll → MP4 download → **YouTube private upload**

### ⚠️ Free plan limits
- JSON2Video: **600 sec/month** (≈ 10-12 Shorts) + chhota watermark
- Gemini free tier: daily limits (manual runs ke liye kaafi)
- Pexels: 200 requests/hour (bahut zyada hai)
- Video **private** upload hoti hai — review karke public karo

💡 Style badalna ho (caption color, font size) to `Build Movie JSON` node edit karo.

assignments.name: TOPIC
assignments.value: Top 3 Unbelievable Facts About Ancient India

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a professional YouTube Shorts producer and scriptwriter for Indian audiences. Topic: ' + $json.TOPIC + '. Voiceover language: ' + $json.LANGUAGE + '. Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these keys: "title" (catchy SEO title under 90 chars), "description" (2 short lines + exactly 5 hashtags including #Shorts), "tags" (comma separated, 10-12 SEO tags), "scenes" (EXACTLY 4 items, each an object with: "hook" = 3-6 word ALL CAPS punchy on-screen caption, "voiceover" = 1-2 engaging spoken sentences of 15-20 words in the voiceover language (if Hindi, write in Devanagari script), "pexels_query" = 2-3 simple English words for searching cinematic stock footage, e.g. "indian temple aerial").' }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}
